o.text: From Arabic عِبَارَة (ʕibāra) which is used with following عَن (ʕan) for the same purpose.
Internationalism. Via Russian диноза́вр (dinozávr), from English dinosaur.
The sense “tangent” is a calque of Russian касательная (kasatelʹnaja).
